notes: §1985:XIV.3.6.4 GR9: identifier-2's content 1/2/3 means ESI/EMI/EGI, "Any character other than 1, 2, or 3 will be interpreted as 0", without identifier-1 only the indicator is sent, and then a content other than 1-3 is an error with no transfer. CommunicationEmitter#Emit passes identifier-2's image to MessageControl#IndicatorOf (one character 1-3, else None), and MessageControlSession#Send answers 60 for no indicator with no text. Witness covers 1,2,3,0,7, indicator-only, and 0/7 without identifier-1 (60). Probes at --std 85: (d) content 4 and 9 then 2 give one segment HHH end 2; REDEFINES content 'A' and space then '3' give HHH end 3; PIC 9P holding 20, PIC 9 COMP and PACKED-DECIMAL holding 2 each end a message (count 3); subscripted IT(S) 0 then 2 gives HH end 2; (b) identifier-1 absent: 1 closes segment, 3 ends group, 'B' gives 60, 2 with nothing pending sends an empty message; GR13 value 0 with ADVANCING and REPLACING accepted and continues the segment.

next.reason: 1985: "The content of the data item referenced by identifier-2 indicates that ... identifier-1 ... is to have an associated end of segment indicator"; 2023: "SEND sends to a message server run unit: "A message is sent to the run unit identified by the content of literal-1 or message-server-name-1"; no indicators". The 2023 SEND statement targets message-server run units and has no cd-name and no ESI/EMI/EGI indicator operand. The 1985 communication module's indicator rule is not carried forward.
